name: Greece
sources: GDP about $90bn and population 10.16m (World Bank / ELSTAT, 1990).

Inflation 20.4% (ELSTAT consumer price index, 1990) - the highest in the European Community by a wide margin. Bank of Greece rates and treasury bill yields ran above 20%; 22.5% is the policy rate used here.
Tax revenue 26% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990) and general government debt 79% of GDP, roughly doubled over the decade.
Defence 4.7% of GDP (NATO defence expenditure series, 1990), the highest share in the alliance after Turkey and the United States, and driven by the Aegean dispute rather than by the Warsaw Pact.

Stability 62: three general elections in ten months (June 1989, November 1989, April 1990), an ecumenical caretaker cabinet under Xenophon Zolotas from November 1989, and the Koskotas affair prosecutions running against Papandreou.
Oil 0.01 mbd from the Prinos field off Thasos, the only producing field in Greece.
